statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n h : ℕ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(h:ℝ)*t))) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let A := fun (n h : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1-h), a k * a (k+h); let model := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime k 30 then (30:ℝ)/8 else 0; let short := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => A n 0 a * V n 0 + 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min n ((L n)^2)), A n h a * V n h); let long := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc ((L n)^2+1) n, A n h a * V n h); ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), S n model t = ((30:ℝ)/8:ℂ)*(∑ r ∈ (Finset.range 30).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r 30 ∧ r ≤ n), E ((r:ℝ)*t)*(∑ j ∈ Finset.range ((n-r)/30+1), E ((30:ℝ)*(j:ℝ)*t)))

plain_statement.zh: 把模 30 模型频谱写成八个几何级数
plain_statement.en: Resolve the modulus-30 model into geometric sums

brief.zh: 按 k mod 30 唯一分组。对 n<30 保留 r≤n，保证自然数截断不多算一项。可直接估计频谱在小分母有理点以外的尾部。
brief.en: Group indices by residue, retaining r≤n even for small n. This gives an explicit spectrum away from the model resonances.
